description.value: Witchcraft Beer Market and Bistro is a neighbourhood pub operated by the Springs Group in Maple Ridge, pouring 40 craft beers on tap sourced from BC breweries and beyond. The kitchen centres on a wood-burning forno oven hand-crafted in Naples, turning out Neapolitan-inspired pizzas made with local organic flour alongside hearty comfort food. The rustic, welcoming space includes a patio and regular live music nights, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley corridor.
